description: Configure Azure AD SSO infrastructure: add MSAL dependency, update config.py with Azure environment variables and production validation (UUID checks, client secret validation, APP_URL validation), compute AZURE_REDIRECT_URI in app/__init__.py at startup, create database index for case-insensitive email lookups, create cross-database verification script
steps: Add msal==1.26.0 to requirements.txt and run pip install
Add import re at top of config.py

Add Azure AD configuration variables to Config class: AZURE_TENANT_ID, AZURE_CLIENT_ID, AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET, APP_URL from environment; derive AZURE_AUTHORITY from tenant ID; define AZURE_SCOPE list; add rate limit config (LOGIN_RATE_LIMIT, AUTH_INITIATE_RATE_LIMIT, AUTH_CALLBACK_RATE_LIMIT) with defaults

Add comprehensive validation to ProductionConfig.init_app(): check required vars present, validate tenant/client IDs are UUIDs using regex, validate client secret >= 32 chars, validate APP_URL format, warn if HTTP used except localhost

In app/__init__.py create_app(), after loading config, compute AZURE_REDIRECT_URI from APP_URL and store in app.config: if app_url: app.config['AZURE_REDIRECT_URI'] = f"{app_url.rstrip('/')}/auth/Microsoft/callback" (capital M)
Connect to SQLite database and execute: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_employee_email_lower ON employees(LOWER(email));
Create verify_index.py script using SQLAlchemy inspector to check for email-related indexes across databases (SQLite, MySQL, PostgreSQL compatible)
acceptance_criteria: ProductionConfig validation raises clear ValueError if Azure variables missing or invalid format
app.config['AZURE_REDIRECT_URI'] is computed at startup and equals APP_URL + '/auth/Microsoft/callback' with capital M
Database index idx_employee_email_lower exists on employees(LOWER(email))
verify_index.py script runs without errors and reports index status correctly
verification: Run: python -c "import msal; print(msal.__version__)" and confirm output is 1.26.0
Run: python -c "from config import config; c=config['production']; print(c.AZURE_AUTHORITY)" with .env configured and confirm authority URL printed
Run: python -c "from app import create_app; app = create_app(); print(app.config.get('AZURE_REDIRECT_URI'))" and confirm output matches APP_URL/auth/Microsoft/callback
Run: python verify_index.py and confirm output shows ✓ Email index exists
Test validation: set FLASK_ENV=production, unset AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET, run python -c "from app import create_app; create_app('production')" and confirm ValueError raised with clear message
findings: All infrastructure configuration completed successfully. msal==1.26.0 installed and verified. Config.py updated with Azure AD environment variables, validation logic, and rate limit configuration. AZURE_REDIRECT_URI computed at app initialization in app/__init__.py. Database index creation documented - init_db.py script created to initialize database and create idx_employee_email_lower index. verify_index.py script created for cross-database index verification. Note: Database does not exist yet in worktree - will be created when application first runs or when init_db.py is executed. .env file copied from parent with all Azure credentials configured (AZURE_TENANT_ID, AZURE_CLIENT_ID, AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET, APP_URL=http://localhost:5000).
